discovery.Customers

Gets customer data from fundamental and reference data as well as symbol conversion data.

Available as lseg.data.discovery.Customers.

Syntax

Customers(instrument: str)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
instrument str Yes Instrument to request.

Methods

get_data

Gets data from the server.

get_data()

Properties

Property Description
df Stakeholders data as a DataFrame; available after get_data() has been called.

Example

customers = Customers("VOD.L")
customers.get_data()
print(customers.df)
